decisions.rationale: Sections 1 and 2 establish and regulate a dispute-specific emergency board and impose report duties. Section 4 ties board termination to actual submission of the section 2 report. Section 3 independently continues status-quo protection until 60 days after that report. Neither the submission deadline nor the later 1986 cleanup revocation establishes the actual first cessation date. The order is nonoperative by the cutoff under its unchanged provisional NO, but the exact earlier lifecycle remains unresolved. The complete saved full_run OCR has been read, including all operative sections, and the acting EO12553 saved official OCR has been read; page images and published GPO fixity were not available in this pilot. No custody authentication or human certification is asserted.

Section 1 establishes the board effective August 25, 1984, although signing is August 24. Section 3 fixes a standstill outer endpoint 120 days after creation (December 23, 1984, on ordinary calendar counting), subject to earlier agreement or other cessation; that conditional date is not asserted as first_end. Section 4 terminates the board only on actual report submission; the report deadline does not prove submission. First cessation of the board and whole order remains unproved. The complete saved full_run OCR has been read, including all operative sections, and the acting EO12553 saved official OCR has been read; page images and published GPO fixity were not available in this pilot. No custody authentication or human certification is asserted.

Amendment (a) substantively replaces the committee function from fostering to studying methods of obtaining. Amendment (b) substitutes a December 31, 1984 termination date expressly conditional on no sooner extension. The parent order EO12426 and any extension, report, or continued functions must be examined before treating that date as the first end. EO12553 establishes a later revocation lead, not proof of the first historical cessation of either amendment. The complete saved full_run OCR has been read, including all operative sections, and the acting EO12553 saved official OCR has been read; page images and published GPO fixity were not available in this pilot. No custody authentication or human certification is asserted.
